doc: Browser-secured credentials (WebAuthn passkeys) under the permission pattern (LCP-036). The pack carries a challenge the engine's server issued to the authenticator and carries the authenticator's answer back, as base64url; it verifies nothing. Attestation, signatures, counters, which user a credential belongs to and what it authorizes are the engine's and its server's. create and get need a user gesture on every browser, because the most restrictive browsers require one; without transient activation they are NeedsGesture and nothing is shown. Unavailability, a missing gesture and the browser's refusal are distinct outcomes. WebAuthn has no permission state to read.

types.name: PermissionState
types.doc: Shared by every permission-sensitive pack. WebAuthn has none; kept so the pack family shares one vocabulary.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: base64url; an opaque handle, never an email address.

variants.name: create
variants.doc: Registers a new passkey. Needs a user gesture.

fields.name: algorithms
fields.doc: COSE algorithm identifiers in preference order, e.g. -7 (ES256), -257 (RS256).

fields.name: excludeCredentials
fields.doc: base64url ids already registered for this user.

variants.name: get
variants.doc: Asks for an assertion. Needs a user gesture.

fields.name: allowCredentials
fields.doc: Empty: any discoverable passkey for this relying party.

variants.name: Created
variants.doc: For the server to verify. Every byte field is base64url.

variants.name: Asserted
variants.doc: For the server to verify. Every byte field is base64url.

variants.name: NeedsGesture
variants.doc: No transient user activation; nothing was shown.

variants.name: NotAllowed
variants.doc: The user cancelled, the ceremony timed out, no credential matched, or user verification failed. WebAuthn deliberately does not say which.

variants.name: AlreadyRegistered
variants.doc: An authenticator holding one of excludeCredentials was used.

variants.name: InvalidRelyingParty
variants.doc: The relying party id is not valid for this origin.

variants.name: NotSupported
variants.doc: No authenticator supports what was asked, such as the algorithm or a resident key.

variants.name: InvalidRequest
variants.doc: A field is not valid base64url.
